organization_rule: A tactical team combines homogeneous units. Each unit has one troop type and one intended standard loadout. Commanders are separate people and never folded into unit soldier averages.
commander_materialization_rule: A cold commander slot must materialize from the team conserved command_personnel or another lawful conserved person source. Never create a free person.
command_personnel_rule: Command personnel are people assigned to command/control duties, not a combat unit. They may be exact/lite or conserved aggregate command personnel until causally important.
resolution: Load unit state for organization; load stats_ref only for units whose capabilities are actually needed. Load command.json only for command-span/order resolution.
